title: Inside the 2026 Home of the Year | Eastbourne House
excerpt:
Eastbourne House by Stevens Lawson Architects is New Zealand's 2026 Home of the Year.

Perched on a dramatic site above Wellington Harbour, this sculptural cliffside home is a masterclass in architecture, materiality, and craftsmanship. Designed to respond to one of New Zealand’s most challenging coastal environments, the house balances grandeur with an intimate sense of human scale.

In this cinematic house tour, we step inside Eastbourne House to explore the ideas behind the design — from its relationship to landscape and light, to the carefully considered material palette that anchors it to its rugged setting.

Explore the full feature on homemagazine.nz: https://homemagazine.nz/home-of-the-year-2026-eastbourne-house-stevens-lawson-architects

Project Details:

Architecture: Stevens Lawson Architects
Build: Planit Construction
Engineer: Sullivan Hall
Location: Eastbourne, Wellington, New Zealand
Award: Home of the Year 2026
Roofing: Metalcraft
Flooring: Forte
Tapware: Plumbline
Furniture: Studio Italia, Matisse, IMO, Jardin, Dawson & Co.
